import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_multilarge_linear_type structure
class GSLMultilargeLinearType(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("alloc", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t)),
        ("free", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(None, ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("reset", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("accumulate", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("solve", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("rcond", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("lcurve", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("matrix_ptr", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_void_p)),
        ("rhs_ptr", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.c_void_p))
    ]

# Define the gsl_multilarge_linear_workspace structure
class GSLMultilargeLinearWorkspace(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("type", ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultilargeLinearType)),
        ("state", ctypes.c_void_p),
        ("p", ctypes.c_size_t)
    ]

# Define the gsl_multilarge_linear_alloc function
gsl.gsl_multilarge_linear_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultilargeLinearWorkspace)
gsl.gsl_multilarge_linear_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLMultilargeLinearType), ctypes.c_size_t]

def allocate_workspace(linear_type, size):
    """Allocate a workspace for large linear problems."""
    workspace = gsl.gsl_multilarge_linear_alloc(linear_type, size)
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate workspace.")
    return workspace
